last_run: Built "How sure are you?": after the picks, people can tap 55, 65, 75 or 90% for how sure they are their call plays out (they can change it until the day after, then it's locked). When calls are graded, My beliefs shows a 'How well-calibrated are you?' card: what they said vs how often they were right, with a Brier score. It waits for 10 graded calls, and says 'leaning overconfident' instead of 'overconfident' when the gap could still be luck. It mirrors their own record; it isn't advice and doesn't affect rankings.
next: Next build: put the brain's own High/Medium/Low label on the same calibration scale so people can compare, or another expert-review item.
